assets.prompt: Create ONE premium contemporary illustrated travel artwork for a wide website hero banner, Christmas in Rome tour, December 23–28. Deliberately and beautifully ARTISTIC, not synthetic stock photography. Sophisticated hand-painted cinematic digital matte painting with visible subtle painterly texture, refined forms, atmospheric depth, editorial travel-poster artistry BUT absolutely NO words, titles, lettering, logo or border. ONE flowing seamless composition, absolutely NO panels, strips, picture frames, cutouts, inset photos, white dividing lines, collage, brochure layout or discrete sections. The entire canvas is one designed piece of art evoking a journey, not claiming to be one literal photographic viewpoint. Strong spacious composition with main landmarks confined to central 65% width and middle 65% height to survive responsive banner cropping; no landmarks near edges. Dominant emotional centerpiece: Christmas in Rome, St Peter's Basilica and its embracing square rendered recognizably with authentic broad low Maderno facade, single Michelangelo dome correctly set behind facade, warm golden lamps and a restrained small Christmas tree, a few tiny human silhouettes. Let warm stone paving and a gently flowing atmospheric sweep carry the eye organically toward a smaller Florence skyline in the distance, recognizably Brunelleschi's red octagonal dome and Giotto's separate slender square bell tower. A subtle blue Mediterranean coastal atmosphere and distant Capri sea-stack silhouettes hint at the OPTIONAL southern Italy excursion; secondary, not equally dominant and no assertive representation that it is included. Do not merge buildings into invented hybrid architecture. Landmarks stand independently in a consciously symbolic painterly landscape joined by light and atmosphere, no hard boundaries between destinations. Rome occupies about 70 percent of attention, secondary destination cues about 20, open sky and atmosphere provide breathing room. Lighting: luminous soft winter dusk, deep indigo and muted periwinkle shadows, elegant amber-gold highlights, subtle rose dusk, restrained saturation, no explosive orange sunset, no plastic surfaces or glossy HDR. Beautiful professionally art-directed proportions, warm inviting Christmas mood, crisp focal detail and painterly atmospheric edges. No transport or new activities depicted. No depiction of actual future Mass or papal appearance. Wide landscape around 2:1. Individual banner image only.
